[SWS_CORE_13004] ViolationMessage PortInterfaceMappingViolation

Dlt-Message
PortInterfaceMappingViolation
Description
The type of mapping does not match the expected type of PortInterface: {portInterfaceTypeName}
referenced by a {mappingTypeName}. String format: "Violation detected in {processIdentifier} at
{location}: Invalid InstanceSpecifer {instanceSpecifier} in a constructor of class: {className}"
MessageId
0x80001ffb
MessageType
Info
DLT_LOG_FATAL
Dlt-Argument
ArgumentDescription
ArgumentType
ArgumentUnit
processIdentifier
Identifier of the process that caused the violation.
uint8 [encoding UTF-8]
NoUnit
location
An implementation-defined identifier of the location
where the violation was detected, for example
{filename}:{linenumber}.
uint8 [encoding UTF-8]
NoUnit
instanceSpecifier
InstanceSpecifier used to try to create the object.
uint8 [encoding UTF-8]
NoUnit
className
Name of the class that was instantiated.
uint8 [encoding UTF-8]
NoUnit
